item.title: Converge Signals, FSI - Data Scientist_Products & Platforms - Deloitte
item.description:
**The Team**
The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.
Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented **Data Scientist** to join the Converge for FSI team and help build differentiated, data-driven financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced analytics and financial services industry expertise, developing the models and insights that power Signals for FSI and future products in the Converge for FSI portfolio.
**Position Summary**
Financial services data holds enormous, often-underused potential - and turning it into decisions the business can act on takes both rigorous technical craft and real industry fluency. As a Data Scientist on the Signals for FSI team, you'll build the analytical engine behind one of Converge for FSI's flagship products, working hands-on with real financial services data to develop models clients can trust. You'll do it on a team that pairs start-up speed with the scale and credibility of Deloitte, giving you room to experiment while your work reaches some of the most influential institutions in financial services.
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.
**Work you'll do**
As the Data Scientist, you will work at the intersection of data science, product, and financial services domain expertise to build and refine the models and analytics that power Signals for FSI:
* Develop, test, and refine statistical and machine learning models using financial services datasets (e.g., consumers, businesses, transactions, accounts, risk, or market data) to power Signals for FSI. * Partner with the Product team to translate financial services use cases into data requirements, features, data signals, and model specifications. * Conduct exploratory data analysis and validate data quality across structured and semi-structured financial services data sources. * Evaluate model performance against business and regulatory considerations relevant to financial services and iterate based on findings. * Translate analytical findings into clear, business-relevant insights for Product, Sales, and client-facing teams. * Stay current on emerging Statistical, AI/ML techniques and financial services data trends, and evaluate their application to the Signals for FSI roadmap.
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
* Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry, with curiosity about how data translates into real client outcomes - early use cases are retail banking, investment and wealth management and insurance, but will expand over time. * Strong analytical rigor paired with sound judgment about when a signal or model is ready to ship versus needing further refinement. * Comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and clear communication with product, engineering, and business stakeholders. * Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams at once. * Collaborative mindset and a willingness to partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring models into production. * Comfortable working through ambiguous, messy problems that require creativity and persistence.
**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. * 4+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, or statistical modeling, including hands-on model development and validation - proficient at using Python, SQL and other data transformation and analytical tools * Ability to travel 10-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
**Preferred:**
* Advanced degree (Master's) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field. * 2+ years of experience working with financial services data (e.g., banking, capital markets, investment management, or insurance) or delivering analytics solutions to financial services clients. * 2+ years of working with customer data to build audiences and segments for sales and marketing use cases. * Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) in a financial services or other highly regulated industry context. * Experience with MCP servers and use of AI to analyze large data sets.
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $122,000-$240,500.
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

**About Collective:**
Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork.
Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures, QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft.
**About the role:**
We’re hiring a Senior Product Data Scientist to build and evolve the core product experiences that power Collective’s member platform. You’ll be the analytical voice in product strategy, working with product, engineering, Operations, Finance, and Go-to-Market to turn member behavior across incorporation, bookkeeping, tax, and payroll into clear insights that shape the roadmap. You’ll own the metrics and analysis behind key decisions end to end, from defining what we measure to making sure the underlying data holds up. This role directly shapes how we help self-employed members save time and money, and how we grow and retain them.
This is a hands-on role for someone who cares about data quality, takes ownership of production systems end-to-end, and wants their work to be the foundation the rest of the company builds on.
**What you'll do:**
* **Drive product strategy with stakeholders.** Work closely with product leads, engineering, Operations, Finance, and Go-to-Market. Share product insights regularly, shape the roadmap, and push back with evidence when the data says something different. * **Lead product analytics.** Approach problems from first principles and turn large, messy datasets into clear analysis and visuals that get to the "so what" and drive product insights across incorporation, bookkeeping, tax, and payroll. * **Use data science to uncover member behavior.** Apply statistical and modeling techniques such as segmentation, cohort, retention, and churn analysis to understand what members do, why they do it, and what it means for the product. * **Find and size growth.** Identify opportunities to grow membership and retention, size them, and help product leads prioritize what to build for the biggest long-term impact. * **Own the metrics.** Define, build, monitor, and report on the metrics behind product strategy and key initiatives, with one tested definition for each. * **Build the data you analyze.** Take raw sources (our product database, payments, support, and third-party tools) through Fivetran and dbt in BigQuery into clean, tested, documented datasets that the whole company can use. Fix problems at the source, not downstream. * **Keep it trustworthy.** Add tests, monitoring, and lineage so a number can be checked in minutes rather than believed on faith. * **Make the data agent-ready.** Maintain the definitions, semantic layer, and documentation that let Claude and our internal data agents answer questions correctly for anyone making a decision. * **Work with urgency and judgment.** Pick up ambiguous, open-ended questions with minimal direction, and deliver with attention to detail.
**What you'll bring:**
* **Experience:** 6+ years in data science, product analytics, analytics engineering, or data engineering, ideally at a B2B SaaS or fintech company. A bachelor's degree in mathematics, statistics, or a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * **An owner's mindset:** you are curious, keep asking "why" until you reach the bottom of a problem, and take initiative without waiting for a ticket. You take ambiguous, high-impact questions and see them through to a decision. * **Range across both sides:** you may be stronger in one, but you can do real work in the other. You can run an experiment analysis on Monday and fix a broken pipeline or model on Tuesday. * **SQL and Python (or R):** expert SQL and strong scripting for analysis, statistics, and tooling. * **Data engineering you have done yourself:** you have taken messy raw sources to trusted, tested datasets that other teams rely on, using a modern stack such as BigQuery, dbt, and Fivetran or similar. You know what good data looks like. * **Experimentation:** you design and interpret A/B and multivariate tests, understand power and guardrails, and build frameworks that turn results into launch decisions. Experience with Statsig, LaunchDarkly, or similar. * **Product analytics:** hands-on with Amplitude, Segment, Metabase, or similar. You turn complex datasets into actionable insights, and you can run exploratory analysis with minimal direction. * **Product sense:** you think through the detailed elements of a product experience and bring creative ideas for growth. * **Communication:** you tell clear, compelling stories with data and explain trade-offs to product leads and cross-functional partners.
**Nice to have:**
* Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment * Exposure to financial, accounting, tax, or payroll data and the correctness bar that comes with it * Experience building semantic layers or metric stores that LLM-based tools query, or running LLM evaluations * AI-assisted development experience (Claude Code or similar) * Prior consulting or investment banking experience * Reforge or similar growth and product certifications
**What we offer:**
* **Hybrid Work Model:** Based in San Francisco with a balance of in-office and remote flexibility. * **Fresh Lunch:** Provided on in-office days. * **Commuter Support:** $150 monthly reimbursement for transit expenses. * **Health & Wellness:** $200 quarterly reimbursement to support your well-being. * **Time Off:** Flexible PTO plus 14 company holidays. * **Comprehensive Coverage:** 100% medical, dental, and vision for employees; 75% coverage for dependents. * **Parental Leave:** 16 weeks fully paid. * **Retirement & Ownership**: 401k plan plus an equity package. * **Team Connection:** Quarterly virtual events and an annual in-person summit.

item.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth - OpenAI
item.description:
Data Science - San Francisco and Seattle
**About the Team**
Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.
**About the Role**
In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.
A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.
**In This Role, You Will:**
* Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth. * Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API. * Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage. * Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider. * Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.
**You Might Thrive in This Role If You:**
* Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest. * Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.
